description: The line plot titled "Efficient Trigger Word Insertion" in the AGNews dataset under a clean-label scenario with a 10% poison rate illustrates the variation of ASR values across different categories. The x-axis categorizes the data into 'cf', 'bb', 'WNBA', 'ESPN', 'NHL', 'FIFA', 'Estadio', and 'athletics', with no units or scale type indicated. The y-axis, labeled 'ASR', has a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 0.9 with a tick interval of 0.1. There are three lines in the plot: a green line with circular markers and a solid line style labeled 'start', a purple line with circular markers and a solid line style labeled 'end', and an orange line with x-shaped markers and a dashed line style labeled 'random'. The 'start' line begins around 0.8 at 'cf', sharply declines to 0.5 at 'bb', then peaks at approximately 0.9 at 'WNBA' and ends at 0.92 at 'athletics'. The 'random' line starts near 0.65 at 'cf', sharply declines to 0.5 at 'bb', peaking at approximately 0.88 at 'WNBA', and ends at 0.85 at 'athletics'. The 'end' line starts around 0.75 at 'cf', showing peaks and troughs, and sharply declines to 0.58 at 'bb', then increases steadily to end at approximately 0.9 at 'athletics'. The 'end' line consistently exceeds the 'random' line across all categories except 'bb', where both lines converge. A legend is provided at the bottom right of the plot.
